name: amazon-clean-dp-url
description: Amazonの商品ページからクリーンな /dp/ URLをコピーするFirefox拡張機能

scripts.dev: bun run build:extension && concurrently --kill-others --names typescript,firefox "bun run watch" "web-ext run --source-dir dist"
scripts.lint: bun run build:extension && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.build:amo: bun run test && bun run build:extension && web-ext lint --source-dir dist && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.submit:amo: bun run test && bun run build:extension && web-ext lint --source-dir dist && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json
